title: Instructional Designer (f/m/d)
description:
Join our design team to create courses for enterprise customers.

What you'll do
- Run content analysis and design learning objectives
- Develop e-learning modules and assessments
- Review learner data and improve courses

What you bring
- Master's degree in education or a related field, or 5+ years in instructional design
- Experience with Articulate Storyline or similar tools
- Strong written English
